title: Check Palindrome Number

content.problemStatement: Write a program to check whether the given number is palindrome number or not.
content.outputFormat: Print Yes if it is palindrome number or print No

sampleTestCases.explanation: Input produces the expected output following problem rules.
Input produces the expected output following problem rules.

solution.approach: Check if integer string is a palindrome.
solution.editorial: Compare string S with its reverse. Print 'Yes' if equal, else 'No'.

hints: Compare characters from both ends moving towards center.
